🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) ↑ rising and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ↑ rising give conflicting signals while credit stress is rising via HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear creeping up: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) ↑ rising. Credit stress edging higher: Credit Spread Level 0.7343 (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.45%) → flat with HYG/LQD showing CORRECTION. Stocks vs bonds still biased to risk: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) vs TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: Dollar showing RECOVERY (Level 27.48 | 1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.19%) → flat and Yield Curve CORRECTION (Level 1.0501 | 1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.37%) → flat, with TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) consistent with muted bond flows.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) showing strength; Financials and Discretionary in CORRECTION (Financials 1W: -2.23% | 1M: +5.83% | XLF CORRECTION) with sector breadth mixed, so Style: Growth/Momentum showing leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US outperforms: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +12.94%). EM mixed with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.01%) while China (FXI) CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) showing regional weakness.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed. IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +9.86%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +9.58%) show ongoing risk interest while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.44%) and the Speculation Index (Level 0.1072 | 1W: -4.26% | 1M: +2.57%) ↓ falling warn of a pullback in momentum.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals mixed: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +9.32%) while Copper/Gold is ↑ rising; Gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) showing profit taking.

8. Energy Trend?
Bifurcated strength in oil: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) while XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) show oil up, gas weak.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed tech/semis leadership with XLK and SOXX ABOVE TREND; divergence from rising VXX and HYG/LQD credit stress signals a mixed tape but not a MAJOR divergence across core ETFs, keeping the regime NEUTRAL.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Growth/momentum via XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) and monitor credit via HYG/LQD; reduce exposure to Healthcare XLV BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) and watch China FXI CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLV BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) and XBI CORRECTION (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +7.55%) on near-term weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) on oil strength. BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) and watch GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) for further downside.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~30 (complacency vs rising fear), Credit Spread/HYG-LQD ~0.73 (credit stress rising), Tech vs Financials Level ~3.12 (rotation signal), SPY/TLT above 8.2 (stocks-biased short-term).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. XLK and SOXX showing relative strength (Growth/momentum). Key risk: rising VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD credit stress signals that could undercut breadth if they persist; monitor credit and volatility for regime tilt.
